NeiEditor.text_encoding_tip: Character encoding of cell text. KCES uses UTF-8, while COM3D2 uses Shift-JIS (CP932). The encoding is detected from cell content when reading, and ASCII-only tables carry no evidence so they are reported as Shift-JIS. An empty value writes as Shift-JIS

commands.additem:
Loads a model into a slot. It also sets the working slot used by later アタッチポイントの設定 / meshmorph / 乳首 / ちんこ / adjcutoff commands.

- `args[0]` model file name (.model)
- `args[1]` slot; falls back to the menu category. `body` reloads the whole body, `handitemr` / `handiteml` force attachment to the `_IK_handR` / `_IK_handL` bones
- when `args[2]` is `ボーンにアタッチ`, `args[3]` is a bone name; when it is `アタッチ`, `args[3]` is the attach slot and `args[4]` the attach-point name
- `split:<slot>=<rule>&<slot>=<rule>…` may appear at any position (the first argument starting with "split" is used, case-insensitively). A rule containing `<` or `>` cuts along a plane (`x<0.5` / `y>0.3`, axis x/y/z); otherwise it is a `|`-separated list of bone names

After loading, every hidden node on the slot is restored and belly-sway follows the menu's isHarayureAvailable setting.

⚠️ `split` must be followed immediately by a colon; without it the parser throws an index exception.
commands.anime:
Plays an item animation.

- `args[0]` slot. Under parent MPN accAcc1–accAcc24 it is resolved to the real slot through GetNewAttachSlot
- `args[1]` animation file name; loaded as `.anm` when no extension is given
- `args[2]` `loop` enables looping (case-insensitive)

⚠️ Fewer than 2 arguments logs an error.
commands.animematerial:
Enables the material animator on one material of a slot.

- `args[0]` slot. Under parent MPN accAcc1–accAcc24 it is resolved to the real slot
- `args[1]` material index
commands.blendset:
Defines a named set of face morph keys (BlendSet) that the expression system can apply by name.

- `args[0]` BlendSet name
- `args[1]` onward: "morph name, value" pairs; the pair count is (argument count − 1) / 2

⚠️ Morph names are lower-cased before matching.
commands.bonemorph:
Rewrites the value range of an already registered bone morph. The numbers are offsets relative to the bone's current local transform, not absolute values.

**9-argument form**
- `args[0]` `pos` / `rot` / `scl` (case-insensitive)
- `args[1]` property name (an MPN property such as `MayuY` or `EyeBallSclX`)
- `args[2]` bone name
- `args[3]`–`args[5]` minimum offset (x, y, z)
- `args[6]`–`args[8]` maximum offset (x, y, z)

**8-argument form**: the type is omitted and always treated as `pos`, followed by property name, bone name and the two offset vectors.

⚠️ Any count other than 8 or 9 logs an error. The property and bone names must match a registered morph exactly, otherwise the lookup fails silently.
commands.color:
Writes a material colour property directly.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` colour property name (e.g. `_Color`, `_ShadowColor`)
- `args[3]`–`args[5]` RGB, each divided by 255
- `args[6]` alpha, also divided by 255
commands.commenttype: Comment. KCES2 1.36.0 has no handler for it in Exec, so it is silently ignored at runtime and only survives as an in-file note.
commands.delitem:
Removes the item from a slot and restores the nodes hidden on it.

- `args[0]` slot; falls back to the menu category

Under parent MPN accAcc1–accAcc24 the parent MPN is used instead and the slot is resolved to the real new-attach slot.
commands.endcommand: End-of-list marker. Execution stops the moment this record is reached; every later command is skipped.
commands.ifcommand:
Copies the item from one MPN slot into another when the target slot is empty.

- `args[0]` `maidprop[<MPN>]` — the slot being tested
- `args[1]` `==`
- `args[2]` `nothing`
- `args[3]` `?`
- `args[4]` `setprop[<MPN>]` — the slot being assigned
- `args[5]` `=`
- `args[6]` `getprop[<MPN>]` (reads that slot's current file name) or a literal file name

MPN names go through Parse.TryParse and are case-insensitive. Nothing is assigned when the resolved file name is empty.
commands.length:
Registers hair-length data so the editor can scale hair-tip bones per group.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` length group name (the group shown in the editor, e.g. `前髪1`, `後髪`)
- `args[2]` bone search mode: `fbrother` (first sibling) / `fchild` (first child) / `all`; **case-sensitive**, anything else asserts
- `args[3]` bone name; `*` is replaced with `.*` and matched as a regular expression
- `args[4]`–`args[6]` minimum scale (x, y, z)
- `args[7]`–`args[9]` maximum scale (x, y, z)

⚠️ Exactly 10 arguments are required, otherwise an error is logged.
commands.mancolor:
Sets the male body colour and refreshes it immediately.

- `args[0]`–`args[2]` placeholders that are never read at runtime but must still be present
- `args[3]`–`args[5]` RGB, each divided by 255; alpha is hard-coded to 1 and cannot be customised
commands.maskitem:
Masks another slot while this item is worn so that it is not rendered.

- `args[0]` slot to mask

The relationship recorded is "current menu category → args[0]". Both names must resolve in TBody's slot table, otherwise nothing happens; an empty argument list is skipped outright.
commands.node消去:
Hides bone nodes on the model.

- `args[0]` node name, matched with IndexOf as a substring; `_ALL_` selects every node
- `args[1]` onward: `slot=<slot>` overrides the default menu category
commands.node表示:
Shows nodes hidden earlier; arguments are identical to `node消去`.

- `args[0]` node name, matched with IndexOf as a substring; `_ALL_` selects every node
- `args[1]` onward: `slot=<slot>` overrides the default menu category
commands.nofloory:
Disables the floor-height (Y) snapping test for a slot.

- `args[0]` placeholder whose content is never read
- `args[1]` slot

⚠️ Writing only one argument throws an index exception; the placeholder is mandatory.
commands.param2:
Writes an extended parameter (the second parameter table) onto a slot for other systems to query.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` parameter name
- `args[2]` parameter value

⚠️ Exactly 3 arguments are required; any other count logs an error and does nothing.
commands.paramset:
Registers a named set of weighted parameters (ParamSet) that the morph/expression system looks up by name.

- `args[0]` parameter-set name
- `args[1]` onward: "**value** name" pairs — the number comes first and the name second, the opposite of blendset

The command name and all arguments are joined with spaces into a single line before parsing, so no argument may contain a space.
commands.prop:
Writes a numeric value into an MPN property.

- `args[0]` MPN name, **case-sensitive** (Enum.Parse; a wrong spelling throws and falls back to null_mpn)
- `args[1]` integer value, clamped to that property's own min / max before being stored
commands.saveitem: Legacy command. KCES2 1.36.0 has no handler for it in Exec, so it is silently ignored at runtime.
commands.set: Legacy command. KCES2 1.36.0 has no handler for it in Exec, so it is silently ignored at runtime.
commands.setname: Legacy command. KCES2 1.36.0 has no handler for it in Exec, so it is silently ignored at runtime.
commands.setslotitem:
Writes a number into an MPN property through the same path as `prop`.

- `args[0]` MPN name, **case-sensitive**
- `args[1]` value, parsed as uint then cast to int, also clamped to min / max

⚠️ The name is misleading: this stores a number, not an equipment file name.
commands.shader:
Replaces the shader of one material on a slot.

- `args[0]` slot (asserts when the name does not resolve)
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` shader name

Once this command has run, tex commands under the skin category no longer restore the shader automatically within the same menu.
commands.tex:
Replaces a material texture and can bind that layer to the infinite-colour / gradation / part-colour system. `テクスチャ変更` is an exact alias.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index, or `<MPN>=<index>&<MPN>=<index>…` to pick by the current parent MPN
- `args[2]` texture property name (e.g. `_MainTex`, `_ShadowTex`)
- `args[3]` texture file name
- `args[4]` PARTS_COLOR name (`MUGEN_COLOR` / `GRADA_COLOR` / `PART_COLOR` …); `GRADA_COLOR` may be followed by `|MUGEN_COLOR` to route the whole area through infinite colour as well
- `args[5]` `mugen` / `grada` / `grada|mugen`, deciding which colour system parses `args[6]`
- `args[6]` colour definition name; may carry a `:<ALPHA_TYPE>=<percent>` suffix (`ALPHA_NONE` / `ALPHA_TEX` / `ALPHA_MAT`; the percentage is multiplied by 0.01)
- `args[7]` save-layer tag, `main` by default. With a colour channel bound it accepts `<tag>:LinkColor=<name>` or `<tag>:LinkColorAlpha=<name>` to follow another colour

⚠️ Writing `args[5]` makes `args[6]` mandatory, otherwise the parser throws. When the material index uses MPN conditions, the set must cover every possible parent MPN — no match asserts and then throws.
commands.useredit:
Sets a material property and records it in the edit save so the editor can restore it.

- `args[0]` save tag
- `args[1]` must be `Material` (case-insensitive); any other value is silently ignored
- `args[2]` slot
- `args[3]` material index
- `args[4]` property name
- `args[5]` property type: `DEFINE` (value `0`/`1` disables/enables a shader keyword), `TEX_OFFSET` / `TEX_SCALE` (value `u:v`), `Color` (value `r:g:b:a`, 0–1); **anything else is treated as a float**
- `args[6]` property value

⚠️ The property name `_ZTest2` is rewritten to `_ZTest`, with value `1` becoming 4 and anything else 8. A property missing from the shader only logs an error.
commands.ver:
Sets the format version used by later additem commands; the initial value is 100.

- with 1 argument the version is `args[0]`
- with 2 arguments it is `args[1]` (`args[0]` is ignored)

Place it before the additem commands it governs.
commands.アイテム:
Executes another menu file, optionally restricted to a sub-slot range or a colour variant.

- `args[0]` child menu file name
- `args[1]` onward: `key=value` options:
  - `colvari=<single char>` — replaces `_i_` in `args[0]` with `_color_<char>_i_` to derive the target file; `colvari=<full file name>` uses the name as given
  - `def=<DEFINE>` — overrides the child menu's define flags
  - `mpn=<MPN>` — overrides the child menu's category
  - `sub=all` (every sub-slot, currently 0–4) or `sub=<start>-<end>` / `sub=<index>`

When colvari matches, an extra colour-variant refresh runs. A missing child menu logs an error.
commands.アイテムパラメータ:
Writes an item parameter onto a slot.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` parameter name
- `args[2]` parameter value

The record is queued and applied only after every other command in the menu has run.

⚠️ Exactly 3 arguments are required, otherwise an error is logged and nothing is queued. Note the spelling `アイテムパラメータ` (メータ, no trailing long vowel), which matches the literal `のアイテムパラメータの` used by `アイテム条件`.
commands.アイテム条件:
Executes another menu depending on the state of a different slot. Three forms exist:

**Test whether the slot holds an item**
`<slot> に何か 有る|無い なら <menu file>`

**Test the slot's current model file name**
`<slot> が <model file> なら <menu file>` — the comparison is **case-sensitive**

**Test an item parameter on the slot**
`<slot> のアイテムパラメータの <name> が <value> なら <menu file>` — name and value are lower-cased before comparison

When the test succeeds the target menu is executed on the main slot.

⚠️ `に何か` / `有る` / `無い` / `が` / `なら` are fixed literals; a misspelling asserts.
commands.アタッチポイントの設定:
Defines an attachment point on the slot of the most recent additem so accessories can mount there.

- `args[0]` attach-point name
- `args[1]`–`args[3]` position (X, Y, Z)
- `args[4]`–`args[6]` rotation as Euler angles (X, Y, Z)

⚠️ Fewer than 4 arguments logs an error and does nothing. Any count other than 7 logs "no angle given" and falls back to no rotation, but still executes.
commands.テクスチャセット合成:
Composites a texture onto a texture layer of the target material, optionally bound to infinite / gradation / part colour.

**Add form**
- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index, or the `<MPN>=<index>&…` conditional form
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` layer index; higher values sit on top
- `args[4]` texture file name
- `args[5]` blend mode (`Alpha` / `Multiply` / `AddNormal` / `AlphaDstAlpha` / `Screen` …)
- `args[6]` PARTS_COLOR name; a pair such as `GRADA_COLOR|MUGEN_COLOR` also routes the whole gradation through infinite colour
- `args[7]` layer index within the group
- `args[8]` `<name>:<ALPHA_TYPE>=<percent>`; defaults to ALPHA_TEX at 100%
- `args[9]` save-layer tag, also expanded into the infinite-colour texture key `tag:material:property`
- `args[10]` TransTex data, several entries separated by `&`

**Delete form**
`del <slot> <material index> <texture property> <layer index>`

⚠️ The add form performs no argument-count check, so fewer than 6 arguments throws an index exception.
commands.テクスチャ合成:
Shares the handler with `テクスチャセット合成` and takes the same arguments, but passes no colour parameters at runtime (infColParam is null), so everything from `args[6]` on — colour, alpha and save tag — has no effect. Use it for plain compositing that needs no colouring.

**Add form**: `<slot> <material index> <texture property> <layer index> <texture file> <blend mode>`
**Delete form**: `del <slot> <material index> <texture property> <layer index>`

⚠️ The add form throws an index exception with fewer than 6 arguments.
commands.テクスチャ乗算: Legacy command. Exec in KCES2 1.36.0 only matches `テクスチャ合成` and `テクスチャセット合成`, so this opcode has no handler and is silently ignored; across the whole assembly it appears only once, in the enum declaration.
commands.テクスチャ変更:
Alias of `tex`; the handler is exactly the same.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index, or the `<MPN>=<index>&…` conditional form
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` texture file name
- `args[4]` PARTS_COLOR name; `GRADA_COLOR` may be followed by `|MUGEN_COLOR`
- `args[5]` `mugen` / `grada` / `grada|mugen`
- `args[6]` colour definition name, optionally with `:<ALPHA_TYPE>=<percent>`
- `args[7]` save-layer tag, optionally with `:LinkColor=<name>` / `:LinkColorAlpha=<name>`
commands.パーツnode消去:
Hides same-named bones on another slot while this item is worn.

- `args[0]` **the slot holding the parts to hide** (used as the dictionary key, so it must be a real slot name)
- `args[1]` node name, matched with IndexOf inside this item's own node tree; `_ALL_` selects everything
- `args[2]` onward: `slot=<slot>` names the slot this command executes from (menu category by default)

⚠️ The two roles are easy to swap: `args[0]` is a target slot name, not a node name. Writing a non-slot name there (as in the legacy `パーツnode消去 Kata glove`) makes the entry unreachable and completely inert; in KCES write `パーツnode消去 glove Kata`.
commands.パーツnode表示:
Shows same-named bones hidden earlier; arguments match `パーツnode消去`.

- `args[0]` target slot name
- `args[1]` node name (IndexOf substring match, `_ALL_` for everything)
- `args[2]` onward: `slot=<slot>` names the executing slot
commands.マテリアル変更:
Replaces one material of a slot with another .mate file.

- `args[0]` slot. Under parent MPN accAcc1–accAcc24 it is resolved to the real slot through GetNewAttachSlot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` .mate file name
commands.リソース参照:
Registers a named resource reference under this menu so other systems can look it up by key.

- `args[0]` reference key
- `args[1]` referenced resource, usually a menu file name

Registering the same key twice overwrites the earlier entry.
commands.半脱ぎ:
Registers the half-undressed menu; equivalent to `リソース参照 半脱ぎ <file name>`.

- `args[0]` menu file name for the half-undressed state
commands.delitemnewattach:
Unloads every new-attach part registered under the current parent MPN. Takes no arguments.

Only meaningful when the parent MPN is one of accAcc1–accAcc24.
commands.partcolor:
Colours regions of a texture through ID textures, each region referencing a colour defined by `partcolordef`.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` main texture file name
- `args[4]` ID texture list separated by `&`; `_` marks an empty position
- `args[5]` onward: colour names, each optionally with a `:<ALPHA_TYPE>` suffix

⚠️ The alpha type is a single value shared by the whole command — with several suffixes only the last one wins. Colour names must already be defined by `partcolordef` in the same menu.
commands.partcolordef:
Defines named part colours for `partcolor` / `partcolorrgb` to reference.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` onward: "colour name, HSL data" pairs

HSL fields: `H` main hue, `S` main chroma, `L` main brightness, `C` main contrast, `SH` / `SS` / `SL` / `SC` the shadow-side equivalents, `T` shadow rate. Omitted fields keep the system default.

⚠️ Arguments must come in pairs; an odd count throws an index exception.
commands.pattern:
Pattern setting. In KCES2 1.36.0 this command only parses the PARTS_COLOR value and then stops — there is no further processing, so it has no runtime effect and is effectively vestigial.

- `args[0]` texture name, or `del`
- `args[1]` PARTS_COLOR name
commands.material:
Sets a material property. It uses the same underlying writer as `useredit`, but carries no save tag and takes no part in the edit save.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` property name
- `args[3]` property type: `DEFINE` (value `0`/`1`), `TEX_OFFSET` / `TEX_SCALE` (`u:v`), `Color` (`r:g:b:a`, 0–1); **anything else is treated as a float**
- `args[4]` property value

⚠️ The property name `_ZTest2` is rewritten to `_ZTest`, with value `1` becoming 4 and anything else 8.
commands.uv定義:
Registers the UV position a mole or tattoo can be placed at, indexed by tag name.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` tag name
- `args[2]` UV coordinate written as `u:v`
commands.ほくろ合成:
Composites the mole texture.

- `args[0]` `hash` or `del`
- `args[1]` required only with `hash`: the ulong hash value

⚠️ Any other spelling asserts and asks for the precompiled command instead. The `hash` form requires the item to be equipped as a sub-slot item.
commands.タトゥ合成:
Composites the tattoo texture.

- `args[0]` `hash` or `del`
- `args[1]` required only with `hash`: the ulong hash value

⚠️ Any other spelling asserts and asks for the precompiled command instead. The `hash` form requires the item to be equipped as a sub-slot item.
commands.ネイル合成:
Composites the nail texture.

- `args[0]` `hash` or `del`
- `args[1]` required only with `hash`: the ulong hash value

⚠️ Any other spelling asserts and asks for the precompiled command instead. The `hash` form requires the item to be equipped as a sub-slot item.
commands.gradacolordef:
Defines a gradation colour curve that `tex` / `テクスチャセット合成` can reference through `GRADA_COLOR`.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` definition name
- `args[2]` written as `x1:y1~x2:y2` it gives the gradation line endpoints; anything else is read as the gradation-rate texture file name
- `args[3]` rate of each control point, separated by `~` (e.g. `0.0~1.0`)
- `args[4]` range of each control point, written `x:y~x:y…`
- `args[5]` HSL colour of each control point, separated by `~`

⚠️ Rates, ranges and colours must have the same number of segments and must not exceed the system's gradation-point limit.
commands.メイク合成:
Composites a makeup texture onto the target material. The save tag is generated by the game as `メイク<MPN name><sub-slot index>` and cannot be set from arguments.

**Add form**
- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` layer index
- `args[4]` texture file name
- `args[5]` blend mode
- `args[6]` COLOR_TYPE: `NONE` / `INF_COLOR` / `PART_COLOR` / `GRADA_COLOR`
- `args[7]` placement written as `u:v`
- `args[8]` HSL colour, read only when `args[6]` is `INF_COLOR`

**Delete form**
`del <slot> <material index> <texture property> <layer index>`

⚠️ The add form requires the item to be equipped as a sub-slot item (a PropBase must exist), otherwise it throws a null reference.
commands.ifdef:
Opens a conditional block: when the condition fails, later commands are skipped until `elseifdef` or `endifdef`. Five condition kinds exist:

- `mpn == <MPN>` — compares against the parent MPN. The keyword `mpn` must be lower-case and the MPN name is **case-sensitive**
- `isplugin in <plugin name>` — checks whether a plugin is enabled
- `ismanhead == true|false` — whether the head uses the male body type
- `ismanbody == true|false` — whether the body uses the male body type
- `<DEFINE name>` — single-argument form, AND-ed with the define flags passed at runtime; **case-sensitive** (e.g. `COLOR_MUGEN`)

⚠️ The interpreter keeps a single skip state and does not support nesting. While skipping, `ifdef` is not re-evaluated, but `elseifdef` always is.
commands.elseifdef:
The else-if branch of a conditional block. Conditions are written exactly as for `ifdef` and are re-evaluated whether or not the interpreter is currently skipping.

- `mpn == <MPN>` / `isplugin in <plugin name>` / `ismanhead == true|false` / `ismanbody == true|false` / `<DEFINE name>`
commands.endifdef: Closes the conditional block and clears the skip state. Takes no arguments.
commands.mugencolordef:
Defines a named infinite-colour layer for `tex` to reference through `mugen`.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` layer name
- `args[2]` HSL data (same fields as `partcolordef`)
commands.partcolorrgb:
Shares the handler with `partcolor`; the difference is that ID textures are looked up per RGB channel, so one ID texture can carry up to three regions.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` main texture file name
- `args[4]` ID texture list separated by `&`; `_` marks an empty position
- `args[5]` onward: colour names, each optionally with a `:<ALPHA_TYPE>` suffix

⚠️ Use this only when the ID textures were authored with RGB-channel regions.
commands.meshmorph:
Adds a persistent mesh morph value to the working slot.

- `args[0]` tag; only `パンツ` and `靴下` are valid today
- `args[1]` morph name
- `args[2]` `def=<percent integer>` (`def=100` means 1.0); the keyword comparison is case-insensitive

The working slot is the slot of the most recent additem, or the menu category when the menu has no additem.
commands.マテリアル参照:
Makes one slot share another slot's material instance, so colour and textures follow automatically.

- `args[0]` receiving slot
- `args[1]` receiving material index
- `args[2]` source slot
- `args[3]` source material index

⚠️ The first pair is the side being rewritten and the second pair is the source. `accUde_2 0 accUde 0` means accUde_2 borrows the material of accUde.
commands.addbonemorph:
Adds a bone morph to clothing (skirt spread) that interpolates with the body shape.

- `args[0]` slot; the source asserts that only `wear` is supported
- `args[1]` morph name; the source asserts that only `裾` is supported
- `args[2]` onward: bone names and their transforms alternate:
  - an argument without `=` starts a new bone name
  - an argument with `=` is a transform written `pos=x,y,z~x,y,z` / `rot=…` / `scl=…` (keyword case-insensitive), the value before `~` being the minimum and after it the maximum

⚠️ A bone name must come before its transform; starting with a transform throws a null reference.
commands.乳首:
Sets the nipple shape state.

- `args[0]` CHIKUBI_STATE: `None` / `固定凸` / `基本凹`

The working slot is the slot of the most recent additem, or the menu category when the menu has no additem.
commands.adjcutoff:
Steps the material's cutout threshold and links each step to a mesh morph (used for stocking thickness/length steps).

- `args[0]` material index
- `args[1]` float property name on the shader, usually `_Cutoff`
- `args[2]` onward: `<threshold>[:<morph name>]`, listed step by step

Switching to a step applies that step's morph name at 1.0 under the `靴下` tag. The working slot is the slot of the most recent additem.
commands.parthidemove:
Hides or moves part of a model per named part, so accessories can make room for each other.

- `args[0]` part name (samples mostly use `C` / `L` / `R`)
- `args[1]` mode, `MOVE` / `HIDE`, combinable with `&` as `MOVE&HIDE`; parsed with Enum.Parse, so it is **case-sensitive** and must be upper-case
- `args[2]` type: `TYPE_SLOT_VISIBLE` / `TYPE_BONE_WEIGHT`
- `args[3]` slot
- `args[4]` onward: `hide=true` / `hide=false` (case-insensitive) and `center=<bone name>`
commands.房tex:
Colours hair strand by strand: a mask texture splits the hair into bundles, each carrying its own gradation colour.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` `<sub-slot index>=<strand label>`
- `args[2]` mask texture name
- `args[3]` `<center>#<width>`; read as 0–1 floats when a decimal point is present, otherwise as 0–255 integers divided by 255
- `args[4]` onward: `<colour layer name>=<texture name>`, where the layer name must already exist in the hairf default colour variant (e.g. `基本` / `1影` / `2影` / `照り返し` / `裏照り返し` / `ハイライト`)

The layer index is fixed to 200 + sub-slot index, the property to `_MainTex`, the blend mode to `Alpha`, and the gradation is taken from the shared `髪色` definition.

⚠️ The second and later records for the same slot share the first record's render target, so command order changes the result. This command requires the item to be equipped as a sub-slot item.
commands.munekagergb:
Layers a breast shadow onto clothing, its colour taken per region from the RGB channels of the ID textures.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` shadow texture name
- `args[4]` blend mode
- `args[5]` ID texture list separated by `&`

The layer index is fixed to 100 and the save tag to `服の胸の影:linkcolor=main`.

⚠️ When the target material's shader name contains `AtC` or `Trans`, the blend mode must be `AlphaDstAlpha`; using `Alpha` logs an error.
commands.mask消去:
Registers a skin mask texture on a slot so skin covered by clothing is cut away.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` mask texture name
commands.munekage:
Layers a breast shadow onto clothing whose colour follows infinite colour as a single region.

- `args[0]` slot
- `args[1]` material index
- `args[2]` texture property name
- `args[3]` shadow texture name
- `args[4]` blend mode

The layer index is fixed to 100 and the save tag to `服の胸の影:linkcolor=main`. Use `munekagergb` when per-region colouring is needed.
