MenuAssetsEditor.icon_file_name_tooltip: iconFileName — icon file name, without the .tex / .sprite extension
MenuAssetsEditor.color_set_text_tooltip: colorSetText — which equipment slot (MPN) this part's color preset belongs to. Once set, the part shares the color preset with that slot and recolors together with it — for example, an accessory with `color_set hair` follows the hair color preset. When unset (null_mpn) the part keeps its own independent color preset
MenuAssetsEditor.priority_tooltip: priority — sort order of the part within the same slot list in the editor UI. Lower values come first; default 0. Equal values are ordered by file name
MenuAssetsEditor.is_man_tooltip: Marks the part as male-only. Superseded by the targetBodyType system — the actual filtering is controlled by targetBodyType (KCES2 1.36.1)
MenuAssetsEditor.is_diff_tooltip: Marks the part as a diff model (offset `_zurashi` / pulled-up `_mekure`). Parts with this marker are not registered in the editor UI's part list and are handled by the dedicated diff panel
MenuAssetsEditor.is_delete_tooltip: Marks the part as an "unload" item. In the editor UI it is grouped under the unload section instead of the normal equipment list; after its commands finish (the actual unloading is decided by the commands), the edit data of the equipped part is cleared as well
MenuAssetsEditor.is_recommend_man_tooltip: Marks the part as male-recommended. Superseded by the attribute system — the actual filtering is controlled by the ManReccomend flag in attribute (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.hide_in_edit_tooltip: Hides the part from the part list in the editor UI. It still works in game; it just cannot be picked manually. For parts equipped only through sets or scripts
MenuAssetsEditor.guid_tooltip: guid — currently has no effect in game; KCES MOD EDITOR recomputes it to a random value when writing, configurable in settings (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.parentId_tooltip: parentId — parent part ID for linked groups. For a diff part, fill in its base part's ID (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.defineTagNames_tooltip: defineTagNames declares which color systems this part supports. The value is the bitwise OR of the tags: base color COLOR_MAMA=1, infinity color COLOR_MUGEN=2, part color COLOR_BUBUN=4, gradient color COLOR_GRADA=8; the game tests them with bit checks (HasFlag). Keep it consistent with the color system actually used by the menu commands — a part declaring only the base color (or nothing) will not show a color editing panel in the editor UI. When several parts share a color preset, their defineTagNames must be exactly equal — this check compares the combined integer, so 3 (base+infinity) is not the same as 2 (infinity) even though both support infinity colors; otherwise the preset cannot be shared
MenuAssetsEditor.defineFirst_tooltip: defineFirst has no effect in the current version (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.attribute_tooltip: attribute is the part's attribute bit flags, affecting recommendation filters and special behavior
MenuAssetsEditor.srcFileHashCRC32_tooltip: srcFileHashCRC32 has no effect in the current version (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.targetBodyType_tooltip: targetBodyType — the editor UI filters parts by this
MenuAssetsEditor.isHarayureAvailable_tooltip: isHarayureAvailable controls the belly physics: None follows the default rule, YureAvailable forces it on, YureDisable forces it off
MenuAssetsEditor.skirt_phys_tooltip: skirt_phys selects the skirt physics version: 2 uses only the new MagicaCloth2 physics; other values additionally run the legacy simulation; default 0 (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.toeLockSlotId_tooltip: toeLockSlotId locks the toe bones' rotation on this slot (as a TBody.SlotID string) during animation playback, keeping a part that shapes the toes from being deformed by animations (KCES2 1.36.0)
MenuAssetsEditor.exportModelFormTextureName_tooltip: exportModelFormTextureName is the shape-mask texture file name (without extension) used in hair-make mode; non-empty marks the part as supporting hair-make, ordinary parts leave it empty
MenuAssetsEditor.exportModelFormTextureName: Shape mask texture for hair-make mode

MaterialAssetsEditor.vector_name_tip: Names come from the full PropertType table: whether a property counts as a vector depends on how it is declared in the shader
MaterialAssetsEditor.keyword_enabled_tip: Maps to the game's EnableKeyword / DisableKeyword call and also sets the float property of the same name to 1 or 0
MaterialAssetsEditor.render_queue_tooltip: renderQueue manually sets this material's render order, directly overriding UnityEngine.Material.renderQueue, and takes effect only when the value is greater than 0; 0 or a negative value counts as “unset”, in which case the shader default order is kept — if the material has a matching .pmat, the .pmat value takes precedence
MaterialAssetsEditor.indexedArrayWidth_tooltip: indexedArrayWidth is not a field carried in the mate file — it is the wire-format array width recorded while decoding
MaterialAssetsEditor.layout_legacy_tip: The KCES1 layout has no room for keywordProps or renderQueue, so this material must be upgraded to the KCES2 10-slot layout before editing them, because KISS changed the file layout but did not change the version number
MaterialAssetsEditor.layout_legacy_short: The KCES1 layout does not support keywordProps or renderQueue
MaterialAssetsEditor.sidebar_select_hint: Select a property on the left
MaterialAssetsEditor.shader_name_tooltip: shaderName is the Unity shader name, e.g. CM3D2/Toony_Lighted_Outline_Tex. The game uses it for the shader and loads the default material of the same name (slashes become __ in that lookup)

KeyFrameEditor.keyframe_tip: Keyframe curve: time and value are 0-1, tangents control the curve shape. Double-click to add keyframes in the visual editor, drag points and tangent handles to adjust
KeyFrameEditor.visual_editor_tip: Double-click to add · drag points to move · select then drag handles for tangents · resize at bottom-right

DynamicBoneEditor.version_tip: (version) Serialization version of DynamicBoneStatus, usually 1000. Normally leave unchanged
DynamicBoneEditor.damping_tip: Damping; decay rate that controls the attenuation speed of bone movement. Higher values result in slower swinging (slower return to original position), lower values result in faster swinging (0=fastest decay, 1=slowest decay), default 0.6
DynamicBoneEditor.elasticity_tip: Elasticity; restoring force that resists positional changes. Controls how quickly bones return to their original positions. 1 means almost no movement (0=no resistance, 1=maximal resistance to displacement), default 0.1
DynamicBoneEditor.stiffness_tip: Stiffness; coefficient determining how well bones maintain their original orientation. Higher values make bones appear stiffer with less deformation (0=softest, 1=hardest), default 0.1
DynamicBoneEditor.inert_tip: Inertia; controls the bone's responsiveness to character movement. Higher values reduce position changes during fast movement (0=full response, 1=partial ignore), default 0
DynamicBoneEditor.radius_tip: Radius; base collision detection range. Larger values increase the collision detection area between bones and other objects, default 0
DynamicBoneEditor.endLength_tip: End Bone Length; when non-zero, creates additional bones at the end of the Transform hierarchy for physics simulation (can be understood as extra bones appended to the last bone segment). Default 0
DynamicBoneEditor.endOffset_tip: End Bone Offset; local coordinate offset for end bones. No end bones will be added if all values are 0, default 0,0,0
DynamicBoneEditor.gravity_tip: Gravity; force applied to bones that automatically eliminates internal stress from initial poses (positive values push, negative values pull on XYZ axes), default 0,-0.05,0
DynamicBoneEditor.force_tip: External Force; continuous force applied to bones (positive values push, negative values pull on XYZ axes), default 0,0,0
DynamicBoneEditor.freezeAxis_tip: Freeze Axis (freezeAxis); constrains bones to move on the plane perpendicular to the chosen axis, i.e. no shaking along that axis (e.g. freezing X keeps bones on the YZ plane). None = no freeze. Default None (0)

ClothParamsEditor.radius_tip: Particle radius (radius); the particle size used for collision detection, i.e. how thick a cloth particle is. Default 0.02
ClothParamsEditor.mass_tip: Particle mass (mass); when connected particles pull on each other the heavier one is harder to move. Heavier at the start and lighter at the end is more stable. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.useGravity_tip: Enable gravity (useGravity); whether gravity is applied to the particles. On by default
ClothParamsEditor.gravity_tip: Gravitational acceleration (gravity) in m/s², about -9.8 in nature. Lower it to make the cloth look softer. Default -9.8
ClothParamsEditor.gravityDirection_tip: Gravity direction (gravityDirection); note this is the ceiling direction in world space, so the default (0, 1, 0) makes things fall down
ClothParamsEditor.useDrag_tip: Enable air resistance (useDrag); whether particles are subject to air drag. On by default
ClothParamsEditor.drag_tip: Air resistance (drag); the higher the value the greater the drag and the faster the particles' inertia decays (they stop swinging sooner). Default 0.02
ClothParamsEditor.useMaxVelocity_tip: Enable max velocity (useMaxVelocity); whether the particle speed is capped. On by default
ClothParamsEditor.maxVelocity_tip: Max velocity (maxVelocity) in m/s; particles never move faster than this. Default 3
ClothParamsEditor.worldMoveInfluence_tip: Movement influence (worldMoveInfluence); how much the body's movement drags the particles along. At 0 the movement has almost no effect. Default 0.5
ClothParamsEditor.worldRotationInfluence_tip: Rotation influence (worldRotationInfluence); how much the body's rotation drags the particles. At 0 the rotation has almost no effect. Default 0.5
ClothParamsEditor.maxMoveSpeed_tip: Max move speed (maxMoveSpeed) in m/s. However fast the body moves, the speed at which particles are dragged is capped here, which stabilises the simulation at high speeds. Default 10
ClothParamsEditor.maxRotationSpeed_tip: Max rotation speed (maxRotationSpeed) in degrees/second. Same role as max move speed, but for rotation. Default 360
ClothParamsEditor.massInfluence_tip: Mass influence (massInfluence); how much particle mass matters when external force is applied. 1 = mass fully applies (heavy particles barely move in wind), 0 = mass ignored. Default 0.3
ClothParamsEditor.windInfluence_tip: Wind influence (windInfluence); 0 = completely unaffected by wind, 1 = 100%. Values above 1 are allowed. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.windRandomScale_tip: Wind random scale (windRandomScale); higher values make the wind strength more random and the motion more irregular. 0 = no randomness. Default 0.7
ClothParamsEditor.useDistanceDisable_tip: Enable distance disable (useDistanceDisable); stop the simulation once the distance to the reference object (usually the camera) exceeds a threshold, to save performance. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.disableDistance_tip: Disable distance (disableDistance); beyond this distance the simulation is turned off. Default 20
ClothParamsEditor.disableFadeDistance_tip: Fade distance (disableFadeDistance); the fade runs between (disable distance − fade distance) and the disable distance. With 20 and 5 the fade happens between 15 and 20. Default 5
ClothParamsEditor.useResetTeleport_tip: Reset after teleport (useResetTeleport); whether the particle position is reset when a teleport is detected. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.teleportDistance_tip: Teleport distance (teleportDistance); moving more than this in one frame counts as a teleport. Default 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.teleportRotation_tip: Teleport rotation (teleportRotation); rotating more than this in one frame counts as a teleport. Default 45
ClothParamsEditor.teleportMode_tip: Teleport mode (teleportMode); Reset = reset the simulation once after a teleport, Keep = keep the simulation running. Default Reset
ClothParamsEditor.resetStabilizationTime_tip: Stabilization time after reset (resetStabilizationTime); particles stuck inside a collider pop out on reset, and this time is spent stabilising them. Default 0.1
ClothParamsEditor.useClampDistanceRatio_tip: Enable clamp distance (useClampDistanceRatio); limits how far particles may travel from the start point, avoiding extreme stretching or shrinking of the shape. On by default
ClothParamsEditor.clampDistanceMinRatio_tip: Min distance ratio (clampDistanceMinRatio); the closest a particle may get to the start point, as a percentage of the initial distance. Default 0.7
ClothParamsEditor.clampDistanceMaxRatio_tip: Max distance ratio (clampDistanceMaxRatio); the furthest a particle may get from the start point, as a percentage of the initial distance. Default 1.1
ClothParamsEditor.clampDistanceVelocityInfluence_tip: Velocity influence (clampDistanceVelocityInfluence); lowering it reduces particles being dragged along by sudden movement, but they also lose inertia. Default 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.useClampPositionLength_tip: Enable clamp position (useClampPositionLength); limits how far a particle may travel from its own origin (its original position). Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.clampPositionLength_tip: Clamp position length (clampPositionLength); the maximum distance a particle may move from its origin, curveable per depth. Default 0.03 to 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.clampPositionRatioX_tip: Clamp position ratio X (clampPositionRatioX); the percentage a particle may move along the origin X axis, 1.0 = 100% (excluding MeshCloth). Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.clampPositionRatioY_tip: Clamp position ratio Y (clampPositionRatioY); the percentage a particle may move along the origin Y axis, 1.0 = 100% (excluding MeshCloth). Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.clampPositionRatioZ_tip: Clamp position ratio Z (clampPositionRatioZ); the percentage a particle may move along the origin Z axis, 1.0 = 100% (excluding MeshCloth). Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.clampPositionVelocityInfluence_tip: Velocity influence (clampPositionVelocityInfluence); lowering it reduces particles being dragged along by sudden movement, but they also lose inertia. Default 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.useClampRotation_tip: Enable clamp rotation (useClampRotation); limits how far a particle may tilt relative to its parent, e.g. to keep bangs in shape. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.clampRotationAngle_tip: Clamp angle (clampRotationAngle); the maximum tilt angle in degrees, curveable per depth. Default 30
ClothParamsEditor.clampRotationVelocityLimit_tip: Clamp rotation velocity limit (clampRotationVelocityLimit); caps how much rotation the clamp-rotation constraint may apply per step. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.clampRotationVelocityInfluence_tip: Velocity influence (clampRotationVelocityInfluence); lowering it reduces particles being dragged along by sudden movement, but they also lose inertia. Default 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.restoreDistanceVelocityInfluence_tip: Velocity influence (restoreDistanceVelocityInfluence); lowering it reduces particles being dragged along by sudden movement, but they also lose inertia. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.structDistanceStiffness_tip: Struct stiffness (structDistanceStiffness); the restoring force of Struct connections (along the original structure, always present). Higher restores faster. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.useBendDistance_tip: Enable Bend connection (useBendDistance); Bend connections skip one particle, making the shape less likely to collapse. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.bendDistanceMaxCount_tip: Bend max connection (bendDistanceMaxCount); the maximum number of Bend connections per particle. More means a stiffer shape but higher cost. Default 2
ClothParamsEditor.bendDistanceStiffness_tip: Bend stiffness (bendDistanceStiffness); the restoring force of Bend connections. Higher restores faster. Default 0.5
ClothParamsEditor.useNearDistance_tip: Enable Near connection (useNearDistance); ignores the original structure and simply links nearby particles. Keeps the shape strong but makes it less deformable. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.nearDistanceMaxCount_tip: Near max connection (nearDistanceMaxCount); the maximum number of Near connections per particle. Default 3
ClothParamsEditor.nearDistanceMaxDepth_tip: Near max depth (nearDistanceMaxDepth); only particles with a depth below this value (0.0 to 1.0, 0 being the start point) take part in Near connections. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.nearDistanceLength_tip: Near point length (nearDistanceLength); particles within this distance of each other are linked by Near connections. Default 0.1
ClothParamsEditor.nearDistanceStiffness_tip: Near stiffness (nearDistanceStiffness); the restoring force of Near connections. Higher restores faster. Default 0.3
ClothParamsEditor.useRestoreRotation_tip: Enable rotation restoration (useRestoreRotation); rotates particles back to their original angle relative to the parent, so hair and skirts stay in shape while still moving. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.restoreRotation_tip: Restore power (restoreRotation); the strength with which the angle is turned back to its original pose, curveable per depth. Default 0.3 to 0.1
ClothParamsEditor.restoreRotationVelocityInfluence_tip: Velocity influence (restoreRotationVelocityInfluence); lowering it reduces particles being dragged along by sudden movement, but they also lose inertia. Default 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.useSpring_tip: Enable spring (useSpring); adds a spring effect to fixed particles (chest jiggle, for example). Only used by BoneSpring / MeshSpring. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.springPower_tip: Spring power (springPower); the strength of the spring. Default 0.017
ClothParamsEditor.springRadius_tip: Spring radius (springRadius); the radius of the sphere the spring affects. MeshSpring only. Default 0.1
ClothParamsEditor.springScaleX_tip: Spring radius scale X (springScaleX); stretches the influence sphere into an ellipse along X. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.springScaleY_tip: Spring radius scale Y (springScaleY); stretches the influence sphere into an ellipse along Y. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.springScaleZ_tip: Spring radius scale Z (springScaleZ); stretches the influence sphere into an ellipse along Z. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.springIntensity_tip: Spring atten intensity (springIntensity); adjusts the overall strength of the direction and distance attenuation curves. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.springDirectionAtten_tip: Spring direction atten (springDirectionAtten); damps the spring force by the angle from the front of the influence sphere — left of the curve is the front, right is the back. Curveable per depth. Default 1 to 0
ClothParamsEditor.springDistanceAtten_tip: Spring distance atten (springDistanceAtten); damps the spring force by the distance from the centre of the influence sphere — left of the curve is the centre, right is the edge. Curveable per depth. Default 1 to 0
ClothParamsEditor.adjustMode_tip: Adjust mode (adjustMode); which two axes are used to detect movement — normally the two axes other than the Root Transform's front axis. BoneSpring / MeshSpring only. Default Fixed
ClothParamsEditor.adjustRotationPower_tip: Adjust rotation power (adjustRotationPower); the strength of the rotation produced by movement. BoneSpring / MeshSpring only. Default 5
ClothParamsEditor.useTriangleBend_tip: Enable triangle bend (useTriangleBend); makes two adjacent triangles return to their original angle, keeping the mesh in shape. MeshCloth meshes only. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.triangleBend_tip: Bend power (triangleBend); higher is stiffer. A mesh with few triangles may become too stiff, in which case lower it. Default 0.5
ClothParamsEditor.useVolume_tip: Enable volume (useVolume); note that nothing in this version of MagicaCloth reads it, so changing it has no effect. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.maxVolumeLength_tip: Max volume length (maxVolumeLength); not read by this version of MagicaCloth, so changing it has no effect. Default 0.1
ClothParamsEditor.volumeStretchStiffness_tip: Volume stretch stiffness (volumeStretchStiffness); not read by this version of MagicaCloth, so changing it has no effect. Default 0.5
ClothParamsEditor.volumeShearStiffness_tip: Volume shear stiffness (volumeShearStiffness); not read by this version of MagicaCloth, so changing it has no effect. Default 0.5
ClothParamsEditor.useCollision_tip: Enable collision (useCollision); runs collision detection against the collider list to stop particles entering the body. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.friction_tip: Dynamic friction (friction); particles touching a collider become harder to move. Higher values mean more friction and slower motion. Default 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.keepInitialShape_tip: Keep initial shape (keepInitialShape); nothing in this version of MagicaCloth reads it, so the value makes no difference. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.usePenetration_tip: Enable penetration (usePenetration); prevents particles from passing through a collider and ending up behind it. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.penetrationMode_tip: Penetration mode (penetrationMode); SurfacePenetration limits how deep particles may penetrate along the chosen axes (use it when the mesh carries the main bone weights and deforms with the animation), ColliderPenetration keeps particles from ending up behind the nearest collider (use it when the mesh has no main bone weights). Default SurfacePenetration
ClothParamsEditor.penetrationAxis_tip: Penetration axis (penetrationAxis); which axis particles may penetrate along, with Inverse for the opposite direction. Only used in SurfacePenetration mode. Default InverseZ
ClothParamsEditor.penetrationMaxDepth_tip: Max connection depth (penetrationMaxDepth); the penetration constraint only applies to particles whose depth is at most this value. Default 1
ClothParamsEditor.penetrationConnectDistance_tip: Connection distance (penetrationConnectDistance); the maximum search distance when looking for the collider a particle binds to. Only used in ColliderPenetration mode; curveable per depth. Default 0.2 to 0.3
ClothParamsEditor.penetrationDistance_tip: Penetration distance (penetrationDistance); how far particles may penetrate, curveable per depth. Default 0.1 to 0.2
ClothParamsEditor.penetrationRadius_tip: Moving radius (penetrationRadius); the maximum radius a particle may move within — it can only travel inside the sphere adjacent to the maximum penetration distance. Curveable per depth. Default 0.3 to 1
ClothParamsEditor.useLineAvarageRotation_tip: Line average rotation (useLineAvarageRotation); automatically adjusts particle rotation to the average angle of the connecting line, which usually looks smoother in line structures such as BoneCloth. When off, particle rotation is fixed to the line direction of the connected child — handy for things like earrings. Note the game source really does spell it Avarage. On by default
ClothParamsEditor.useFixedNonRotation_tip: Fixed non-rotation (useFixedNonRotation); when on, fixed particles do not rotate at all; when off they rotate along with the moving particles they are linked to. Off by default
ClothParamsEditor.bezier_startValue_tip: Start value (startValue); the value at depth 0 (the fixed-particle side), and the baseline of the whole curve
ClothParamsEditor.bezier_endValue_tip: End value (endValue); the value at depth 1 (the moving-particle side). It only applies when Use End is on, otherwise the end uses the start value too
ClothParamsEditor.bezier_useEndValue_tip: Use end value (useEndValue); when off, endValue is ignored and the whole curve uses startValue. It is also a prerequisite for the curve value
ClothParamsEditor.bezier_curveValue_tip: Curve value (curveValue); the bend strength between start and end, from -1 to 1. 0 is a straight line, positive bows the middle toward the start value and negative toward the end value. Needs both Use End and Use Curve on
ClothParamsEditor.bezier_useCurveValue_tip: Use curve value (useCurveValue); when off, curveValue is ignored and the curve interpolates straight from start to end
ClothParamsEditor.bezier_curve_hint: Drag a control point to edit the value: left end = start value, right end = end value, middle = curve value. The dashed line is the straight reference — the further the curve sits from it, the stronger the curvature. The vertical axis is the suggested range for this parameter

ColliderEditor.parentName_tip: Parent Name (parentName); the parent Transform the collider attaches to. Must be a valid bone node, otherwise the game reports the error 「物理体親ボーンがありません。」
ColliderEditor.selfName_tip: Self Name (selfName); the collider's own node name (becomes the collider Transform's name on load)
ColliderEditor.localPosition_tip: Local Position (localPosition); position of the collider relative to its parent. Default 0, 0, 0
ColliderEditor.localRotation_tip: Local Rotation (localRotation); rotation quaternion (x, y, z, w) relative to the parent. Default 0, 0, 0, 1
ColliderEditor.localScale_tip: Local Scale (localScale); local scale of the collider relative to its parent. Default 1, 1, 1
ColliderEditor.center_tip: Center (center); the collider's center point in local coordinates. Default 0, 0, 0
ColliderEditor.bound_tip: Bound (bound); Outside = prevents bones from entering the collider, Inside = keeps bones inside the collider. Default Outside
ColliderEditor.version_tip: (version) serialization version of the collider, usually 1000 (1002 for MaidProp). Normally leave unchanged
ColliderEditor.direction_tip: Direction (direction); the reference axis — the long axis for a capsule, the normal for a plane. 0=X, 1=Y, 2=Z. Default Y
ColliderEditor.isDirectionInverse_tip: Invert Direction (isDirectionInverse); whether to reverse the collider's direction. Default off
ColliderEditor.startRadius_tip: Start Radius (startRadius); radius at the start side of the capsule. Default 0.5
ColliderEditor.endRadius_tip: End Radius (endRadius); radius at the end side of the capsule. Default 0.5
ColliderEditor.height_tip: Length (height); length of the capsule. Default 0
ColliderEditor.radius_tip: Radius (radius); radius of the sphere collider. Default 0.5
ColliderEditor.limbType_tip: Limb Type (limbType); which limb's collider this entry uses. The collider itself is predefined by the game — TBody's LimbColliderMgr reads it from limbconf.limbcol (one shared set for the whole body), attaches it to the limb bone, and derives its length from the distance to the next bone
ColliderEditor.isEnable_tip: Enabled (isEnable); whether the swaying object that owns this file (hair, sleeve, ...) uses this limb's predefined collider. When off, that object's particles pass through the limb. The switch only affects the object using this file — it is not a global collision setting
ColliderEditor.maidprop_extras_tip: These parameters make the collider follow the body MPN sliders. The collider hangs on the breast bone and pushes back the swaying object that owns this file — the effect is "this piece of hair/clothing does not sink into the chest", and the breast itself does not deform because of it. Chest size is slider-driven, so a fixed size would clip once a player enlarges the chest; hence each entry says which sliders affect the collider and how big it becomes when they are maxed out, and the game interpolates linearly between the two. In the official files these colliders all sit on the left and right breast (Mune_L / Mune_R) — the radius growing from 0.03 to 0.0944 is exactly this. You only need to touch it when you changed a base size and want the collider to fit both small and large bodies
ColliderEditor.centerMpnList_tip: centerMpnList (Key 16); the MPN sliders that drive the collider center interpolation — the game uses the largest normalised value among them as t. An empty list, or sliders all at 0, gives t=0 and the center stays at center
ColliderEditor.centerRateMax_tip: centerRateMax (Key 17); the collider center in local coordinates when those sliders are at maximum (t=1). At t=0 the center field is used instead
ColliderEditor.startRadiusMpnList_tip: startRadiusMpnList (Key 18); the MPN sliders that drive the start-radius interpolation, using the largest normalised value among them as t
ColliderEditor.maxStartRadius_tip: maxStartRadius (Key 19); the start radius when the sliders are at maximum (t=1). Start radius = Lerp(startRadius, maxStartRadius, t), so startRadius is the minimum at slider 0. Default 1
ColliderEditor.endRadiusMpnList_tip: endRadiusMpnList (Key 20); the MPN sliders that drive the end-radius interpolation, using the largest normalised value among them as t
ColliderEditor.maxEndRadius_tip: maxEndRadius (Key 21); the end radius when the sliders are at maximum (t=1). End radius = Lerp(endRadius, maxEndRadius, t), so endRadius is the minimum at slider 0. Default 1
ColliderEditor.mpn_name_list_tip: Name mirror of the matching enum list (Keys 22-24), regenerated by the game with MPN.ToString() on save — nothing to fill in here, it is shown read-only. Note that when loading a version >= 1002 file the game derives centerMpnList from centerMpnNameList (the start/end pairs still read their enum lists), so the two must agree; this editor keeps them in sync when you edit the slider list above
ColliderEditor.mpn_name_list_absent: Absent in older files (the game regenerates it from the enum list)

ModelEditor.mesh_data_hint: Edit mesh-level data (bone transforms, morphs, skin thickness) in JSON mode
ModelEditor.file_name_tooltip: fileName — never read when loading; used only for the GameObject name and some auto-generated bone names. Must carry the .model extension
ModelEditor.mesh_file_name_tooltip: meshFileName — the mesh resource name. A KCES model contains no mesh data; the loader reads the referenced mesh file here. Must carry the .mmesh or .kcmodel extension
ModelEditor.modelName_tooltip: modelName — the name of the node that serves as the SkinnedMeshRenderer attach point among transData[]. It must exactly match one of the transData names, or the game crashes. The name cannot contain a colon (:)
ModelEditor.material_file_name_tooltip: materialFileName — the .mate file names to load, with the .mate suffix. The order corresponds to the sub-meshes and should not be changed casually. A KCES model contains no material data, so .mate files are required
ModelEditor.id_tooltip: id — the FNV-1a hash of the file name, but a model's id is not used by the game

MagicaClothEditor.instance_ref_tip: Unity scene object reference (instanceID), not editable here
MagicaClothEditor.empty_payload_hint: The MagicaCloth2 payload of a new document is empty. Open an existing file to copy parameters, or switch to JSON mode and paste full data first
MagicaClothEditor.range_hint: Range {{min}} to {{max}}, factory default {{def}}. The game clamps out-of-range values when loading
MagicaClothEditor.use_curve_tip: When on, the value comes from the curve: effective value = curve value at that particle × the number on the left. When off, only the number on the left is used
MagicaClothEditor.ignored_tip: When the game loads this file it restores this member from the live scene, so editing it does not change in-game behaviour, but the value is still written back to the file as-is
MagicaClothEditor.import_json_notice: On load the game first overwrites its parameters from this document, then restores some members from the live scene. Members marked "no effect" do not change in-game behaviour, but are still written back to the file as-is
MagicaClothEditor.group_ignored_notice: Every member in this group is rebuilt from the scene when the game loads, so edits do not change in-game behaviour
MagicaClothEditor.group_scene: Build and scene settings (no effect on load)
MagicaClothEditor.angleLimitConstraint_tip: Angle limit (angleLimitConstraint); limits how far a baseline edge may bend relative to its parent, e.g. to stop bangs folding too far
MagicaClothEditor.angleLimitConstraint__limitAngle_tip: Limit angle (angleLimitConstraint.limitAngle); the angle in degrees each edge may bend from its parent, curveable per depth. Default 60
MagicaClothEditor.angleLimitConstraint__stiffness_tip: Stiffness (angleLimitConstraint.stiffness); the repulsive force at the limit — lower values return softly. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.angleLimitConstraint__useAngleLimit_tip: Use angle limit (angleLimitConstraint.useAngleLimit); off by default
MagicaClothEditor.angleRestorationConstraint_tip: Angle restoration (angleRestorationConstraint); rotates the baseline edges back to their original angle. This is the single most important parameter for the cloth's overall motion
MagicaClothEditor.angleRestorationConstraint__gravityFallo: Gravity falloff (angleRestorationConstraint.gravityFalloff); at 1.0 the restoring force becomes 0 when the cloth faces against gravity, which stops hair snapping back when the character is upside down. It works even if gravity is set to 0
MagicaClothEditor.angleRestorationConstraint__stiffness_ti: Stiffness (angleRestorationConstraint.stiffness); how much of the angle is restored per correction — higher restores faster. Default 0.2
MagicaClothEditor.angleRestorationConstraint__useAngleRest: Use angle restoration (angleRestorationConstraint.useAngleRestoration); on by default
MagicaClothEditor.angleRestorationConstraint__velocityAtte: Velocity attenuation (angleRestorationConstraint.velocityAttenuation); the velocity damping applied while restoring. Lower it and the cloth springs and bounces; raise it and it returns gently. Default 0.8
MagicaClothEditor.animationPoseRatio_tip: Animation pose ratio (animationPoseRatio); whether Angle Restoration, Angle Limit and Shape Restoration restore toward the initial pose or the current animation pose. 0.0 = initial pose (usually more stable), 1.0 = current animation pose. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.blendWeight_tip: Blend Weight (blendWeight); the weight used when writing the simulation result back to the position. 1 = fully simulated, 0 = keeps the pre-simulation position (the animation pose). At runtime it is multiplied by the weights from reset stabilization and distance-culling fade. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.clothType_tip: Cloth type (clothType); BoneCloth = cloth simulation on Transforms (hair, accessories, cheap), MeshCloth = simulates mesh vertices (more realistic but heavier), BoneSpring = a spring on Transforms (chest jiggle)
MagicaClothEditor.colliderCollisionConstraint_tip: Collider collision (colliderCollisionConstraint); runs collision detection against the collider list to stop the cloth entering the body
MagicaClothEditor.colliderCollisionConstraint__colliderLis: Collider list (colliderCollisionConstraint.colliderList); colliders must be registered here to take part in detection. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.colliderCollisionConstraint__collisionBo: Collision bones (colliderCollisionConstraint.collisionBones); BoneSpring only — the Transforms to detect against must be registered here. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.colliderCollisionConstraint__friction_ti: Friction (colliderCollisionConstraint.friction); higher values make vertices harder to slide over colliders, i.e. they stop sooner. Default 0.05
MagicaClothEditor.colliderCollisionConstraint__limitDistan: Limit distance (colliderCollisionConstraint.limitDistance); BoneSpring only — limits how far a vertex may move from its origin, and the collider's repulsion weakens with distance
MagicaClothEditor.colliderCollisionConstraint__mode_tip: Mode (colliderCollisionConstraint.mode); Point = vertex-sphere collision, cheap but small colliders can slip through; Edge = edge collision, no slip-through but more expensive. Fixed to Point in BoneSpring. Default None
MagicaClothEditor.connectionMode_tip: Connection mode (connectionMode); how BoneCloth builds baselines from the bones. Line = straight from the hierarchy, AutomaticMesh / SequentialLoopMesh / SequentialNonLoopMesh = built from the mesh automatically. Default Line
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings_tip: Culling (cullingSettings); stops the simulation when the character is not drawn by the camera or is too far away, saving performance. Note the whole group is rebuilt from the scene when loading
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings__cameraCullingMethod_tip: Camera culling method (cullingSettings.cameraCullingMethod); which renderers are used to judge visibility. AutomaticRenderer = collected from the Animator, ManualRenderer = specified by hand. Default AutomaticRenderer
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings__cameraCullingMode_tip: Camera culling mode (cullingSettings.cameraCullingMode); what happens when hidden from the camera. Off = no culling, Reset = reset the simulation, Keep = pause it, AnimatorLinkage = follow the Animator's CullingMode. Default Off
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings__cameraCullingRenderers_: Camera culling renderers (cullingSettings.cameraCullingRenderers); used to judge visibility when the method is Manual. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings__distanceCullingFadeRati: Distance culling fade ratio (cullingSettings.distanceCullingFadeRatio); blends the running and disabled states so the transition looks smoother. It is a ratio of the culling distance. Default 0.2
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings__distanceCullingLength_t: Distance culling length (cullingSettings.distanceCullingLength); turns distance culling on and sets the threshold — beyond this distance from the reference object the simulation stops. Default 30
MagicaClothEditor.cullingSettings__distanceCullingReferenc: Distance culling reference object (cullingSettings.distanceCullingReferenceObject); the object the distance is measured from. Left as None it uses the main camera. The distance is computed between it and this component. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.customSkinningSetting_tip: Custom skinning (customSkinningSetting); adds skinning information to the proxy mesh when the source mesh is not skinned to the bones it needs. It is only a fallback and far less accurate than manual weighting
MagicaClothEditor.customSkinningSetting__skinningBones_tip: Skinning bones (customSkinningSetting.skinningBones); the bones used for skinning — every proxy-mesh vertex is skinned to them. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.damping_tip: Damping (damping); higher values make vertices move slower and settle sooner, lower values let them keep going. Default 0.05
MagicaClothEditor.distanceConstraint_tip: Distance constraint (distanceConstraint); keeps each vertex at its original distance from the vertices it connects to — the most basic shape-preserving constraint
MagicaClothEditor.distanceConstraint__stiffness_tip: Distance stiffness (distanceConstraint.stiffness); the restoring force of the distance constraint. 1.0 is usually fine, but too strong a constraint stops the cloth stretching — for skirts it can help to weaken it near the end with a curve. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.gravity_tip: Gravity (gravity); the gravity factor applied to the whole cloth, in m/s². Default 5, lower than the real 9.8 to keep the motion softer
MagicaClothEditor.gravityDirection_tip: Gravity direction (gravityDirection); specified in world coordinates. The default (0, -1, 0) points down
MagicaClothEditor.gravityFalloff_tip: Gravity falloff (gravityFalloff); damps gravity by the cloth's orientation. At 1.0 the cloth receives no gravity in its initial posture, and gravity grows as it tilts
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint_tip: Inertia (inertiaConstraint); how the character's movement affects cloth vertices. Split into anchor, world and local parts that can be tuned separately
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__anchor_tip: Anchor (inertiaConstraint.anchor); excludes the movement of the specified object from inertia — useful for negating the effect of moving floors or vehicles. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__anchorInertia_tip: Anchor inertia (inertiaConstraint.anchorInertia); the influence factor of the anchor. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__centrifualAcceleratio: Centrifugal acceleration (inertiaConstraint.centrifualAcceleration); a multiplier that increases the centrifugal force. Note the game source really does spell it centrifual
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__depthInertia_tip: Local depth inertia (inertiaConstraint.depthInertia); reduces local inertia by vertex depth. Higher values make vertices near the start point harder to move while the end point is unaffected. Good for skirts and hair
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__localInertia_tip: Local inertia (inertiaConstraint.localInertia); how movement inside the character's local space (usually the animation) affects vertices. 0.2 applies 20% of the local displacement. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__localMovementSpeedLim: Local movement speed limit (inertiaConstraint.localMovementSpeedLimit); above this speed the local movement stops transmitting force. Default 5
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__localRotationSpeedLim: Local rotation speed limit (inertiaConstraint.localRotationSpeedLimit) in degrees/second. Default 720
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__movementInertia_tip: Movement inertia (inertiaConstraint.movementInertia); an early-layout member superseded by world/local inertia in the current source, so changing it usually has no effect
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__movementInertiaSmooth: World inertia smoothing (inertiaConstraint.movementInertiaSmoothing); smooths the character's inertia to reduce disturbances from sudden starts and stops. Default 0.4
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__movementSpeedLimit_ti: World movement speed limit (inertiaConstraint.movementSpeedLimit); above this speed (m/s) no more force is transmitted to the cloth. Generally recommended over lowering world inertia. Default 5
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__particleSpeedLimit_ti: Particle speed limit (inertiaConstraint.particleSpeedLimit); caps the per-vertex speed, which relieves the tip of a long belt-like object bulging outward from centrifugal force. Below 1 m/s collision accuracy drops. Default 4
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__rotationInertia_tip: Rotation inertia (inertiaConstraint.rotationInertia); an early-layout member superseded by world/local inertia in the current source, so changing it usually has no effect
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__rotationSpeedLimit_ti: World rotation speed limit (inertiaConstraint.rotationSpeedLimit) in degrees/second; same role as the movement limit but for rotation. Default 720
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__teleportDistance_tip: Teleport distance (inertiaConstraint.teleportDistance); moving more than this (m) in one frame counts as a teleport. Default 0.5
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__teleportMode_tip: Teleport mode (inertiaConstraint.teleportMode); None = no automatic teleport detection, Reset = reset the simulation after a teleport, Keep = keep the simulation running after a teleport. Default None
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__teleportRotation_tip: Teleport rotation (inertiaConstraint.teleportRotation); rotating more than this (degrees) in one frame counts as a teleport. Default 90
MagicaClothEditor.inertiaConstraint__worldInertia_tip: World inertia (inertiaConstraint.worldInertia); how the character's movement through the world affects the cloth. 0.1 adds 10% of the character's movement. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.meshWriteMode_tip: Mesh write mode (meshWriteMode); what MeshCloth writes back into the mesh. PositionAndNormal = position and normal, PositionAndNormalTangent = position, normal and tangent
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint_tip: Movement limit (motionConstraint); restricts where vertices may move relative to the animation-pose vertex normals. Also called a backstop — it keeps bangs out of the head or clothes out of the body without needing colliders
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint__backstopDistance_tip: Backstop distance (motionConstraint.backstopDistance); how far the sphere is offset from the animation-pose vertex along the opposite of the normal. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint__backstopRadius_tip: Backstop radius (motionConstraint.backstopRadius); the radius of the backstop collision sphere. Default 10, which is effectively no limit
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint__maxDistance_tip: Max distance (motionConstraint.maxDistance); how far a vertex may move from its animation-pose position — it stays inside a sphere of this radius. Default 0.3
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint__stiffness_tip: Stiffness (motionConstraint.stiffness); the repulsive force at the limit — lower values return softly. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint__useBackstop_tip: Use backstop (motionConstraint.useBackstop); whether vertices are kept out of the sphere placed on the opposite side of the normal. Off by default
MagicaClothEditor.motionConstraint__useMaxDistance_tip: Use max distance (motionConstraint.useMaxDistance); whether the maximum distance from the animation-pose vertex is limited. On by default
MagicaClothEditor.normalAlignmentSetting_tip: Normal alignment (normalAlignmentSetting); adjusts the proxy mesh's normal directions. Normals feed backstops and springs; only the proxy mesh is changed, not the actual Transform or mesh
MagicaClothEditor.normalAlignmentSetting__adjustmentTransf: Adjustment transform (normalAlignmentSetting.adjustmentTransform); when the mode is Transform, normals radiate from this Transform's centre. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.normalAlignmentSetting__alignmentMode_ti: Alignment mode (normalAlignmentSetting.alignmentMode); None = no adjustment, BoundingBoxCenter = radiate from the proxy mesh's bounding-box centre, Transform = radiate from the given Transform's centre. Default None
MagicaClothEditor.normalAxis_tip: Normal axis (normalAxis); which axis of the proxy-mesh vertex pose is used as the normal. Normals are used by backstops and springs. Default Up
MagicaClothEditor.paintMapUvChannel_tip: Paint map UV channel (paintMapUvChannel); which UV set is used to sample the paint map. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.paintMaps_tip: Paint maps (paintMaps); the textures used for vertex painting, one per source renderer. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.paintMode_tip: Paint mode (paintMode); the mode used when marking vertex attributes with a texture. Manual = painted by hand; the other two read Fixed/Move/Ignore from the RD/GR/BK channels
MagicaClothEditor.radius_tip: Radius (radius); the radius of the vertex sphere used for collision detection — in Edge mode, the radius of the edge. Default 0.02
MagicaClothEditor.reductionSetting_tip: Reduction (reductionSetting); merges some proxy-mesh vertices for better performance and a more stable simulation — but over-simplifying weakens collision detection
MagicaClothEditor.reductionSetting__shapeDistance_tip: Shape distance (reductionSetting.shapeDistance); merges nearby vertices based on the mesh shape — vertices not connected as a surface are not merged even when close. 0 = no reduction. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.reductionSetting__simpleDistance_tip: Simple distance (reductionSetting.simpleDistance); simply merges nearby vertices without considering the mesh structure. 0 = no reduction. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.rootBones_tip: Root bones (rootBones); BoneCloth starts simulating from these root Transforms. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.rootRotation_tip: Root rotation (rootRotation); rotation adjustment of fixed Transforms. 0.0 does not rotate from the original posture, 1.0 rotates toward the child (averaged if there are several), 0.5 is in between. BoneCloth / BoneSpring only. Default 0.5
MagicaClothEditor.rotationalInterpolation_tip: Rotational interpolation (rotationalInterpolation); rotation adjustment of moving Transforms. 0.0 rotates toward the parent, 1.0 toward the child (averaged if there are several), 0.5 is in between. A terminal Transform always rotates toward its parent. BoneCloth / BoneSpring only. Default 0.5
MagicaClothEditor.selfCollisionConstraint_tip: Self collision (selfCollisionConstraint); lets the cloth collide with itself (or with another cloth) so overlapping parts do not penetrate. MagicaSoft marks this as beta: expensive and prone to vibration
MagicaClothEditor.selfCollisionConstraint__clothMass_tip: Cloth mass (selfCollisionConstraint.clothMass); the weight of this cloth in mutual collisions — heavier cloth is less easily pushed. Prevents small accessories from pushing down a large skirt. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.selfCollisionConstraint__selfMode_tip: Self mode (selfCollisionConstraint.selfMode); None = off, FullMesh = point-triangle and edge-edge detection against its own cloth. Default None
MagicaClothEditor.selfCollisionConstraint__surfaceThicknes: Surface thickness (selfCollisionConstraint.surfaceThickness); the thickness used for self collision — the vertex sphere radius plays no part. Note it is the sum of both primitives' thickness. Default 0.005
MagicaClothEditor.selfCollisionConstraint__syncMode_tip: Sync mode (selfCollisionConstraint.syncMode); runs the same detection against the partner cloth, letting separately configured cloths collide with each other. Default None
MagicaClothEditor.selfCollisionConstraint__syncPartner_tip: Sync partner (selfCollisionConstraint.syncPartner); the mutual-collision opponent. Only one can be set. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.sourceRenderers_tip: Source renderers (sourceRenderers); the renderers MeshCloth builds its proxy mesh from. Note this member is not applied when loading
MagicaClothEditor.springConstraint_tip: Spring (springConstraint); adds a spring effect to fixed vertices. Only BoneSpring uses it, and it only affects vertices marked Fixed
MagicaClothEditor.springConstraint__limitDistance_tip: Limit distance (springConstraint.limitDistance); the maximum distance a vertex may move from its origin. Default 0.1
MagicaClothEditor.springConstraint__normalLimitRatio_tip: Normal limit ratio (springConstraint.normalLimitRatio); the ratio of movement along the normal. Combined with limit distance it turns the movement range into an ellipse. Normals can be changed in Normal Settings. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.springConstraint__springNoise_tip: Spring noise (springConstraint.springNoise); the spring asynchrony rate. With two or more fixed vertices it adds a little noise to each so they do not move in lockstep. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.springConstraint__springPower_tip: Spring power (springConstraint.springPower); the strength of the spring. MagicaSoft suggests keeping it in 0.001 to 0.2. Default 0.04
MagicaClothEditor.stablizationTimeAfterReset_tip: Stabilization time (stablizationTimeAfterReset); the stabilisation time in seconds during initialization or reset. If the cloth and a collider overlap at the start, vertices get pushed out at once and the cloth deforms badly — this time suppresses that. Default 0.1
MagicaClothEditor.tetherConstraint_tip: Tether constraint (tetherConstraint); limits how close a vertex may get to the start of its baseline, preventing the cloth from shrinking too much
MagicaClothEditor.tetherConstraint__distanceCompression_ti: Tether compression (tetherConstraint.distanceCompression); the percentage of the distance a vertex may shrink toward its origin — 0.6 lets it reach the 40% circle but no further. Usually keep 0.8 or above. Default 0.4
MagicaClothEditor.triangleBendingConstraint_tip: Triangle bending constraint (triangleBendingConstraint); makes two adjacent triangles return to their original angle — important for keeping a MeshCloth in shape. Has no effect if the proxy mesh has no triangles
MagicaClothEditor.triangleBendingConstraint__stiffness_tip: Triangle bending stiffness (triangleBendingConstraint.stiffness); triangle resilience. Basically keep 1.0; a shape with few triangles may become too stiff, in which case lower it. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.updateMode_tip: Update mode (updateMode); which loop advances the simulation time. Normal = Update(), UnityPhysics = the physics loop (pick this when the character moves in FixedUpdate), Unscaled = ignores timeScale, AnimatorLinkage = follows Animator.UpdateMode automatically. Getting it wrong causes inexplicable oscillation. Default AnimatorLinkage
MagicaClothEditor.wind_tip: Wind (wind); how wind affects the cloth. A wind component such as Directional Wind must exist in the scene for any wind to reach it
MagicaClothEditor.wind__blend_tip: Noise blend (wind.blend); the blend ratio between the sine waveform and the noise waveform. Default 0.7
MagicaClothEditor.wind__depthWeight_tip: Depth weight (wind.depthWeight); higher values mean vertices near the start point are less affected by wind, which stabilises skirts and bangs. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.wind__frequency_tip: Frequency (wind.frequency); the period of the swaying waveform, i.e. how fast it oscillates. Values above 1 are allowed. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.wind__influence_tip: Influence (wind.influence); the overall wind influence on the cloth. Lower it to weaken the effect globally; values above 1 are allowed. Default 1
MagicaClothEditor.wind__movingWind_tip: Moving wind (wind.movingWind); automatically generates wind from the cloth's own movement — higher values mean stronger wind while moving. Default 0
MagicaClothEditor.wind__synchronization_tip: Synchronization (wind.synchronization); how in sync the baselines move — 1.0 is identical, 0.0 is completely separate. Default 0.7
MagicaClothEditor.wind__turbulence_tip: Turbulence (wind.turbulence); the turbulence rate, i.e. how large the disturbance is. Values above 1 are allowed. Default 1

PMatAssetsEditor.render_queue_tooltip: renderQueue overrides the render queue of the target material from the outside. Unlike .mate, this value has no zero guard: even 0 is written, which restores the queue to the shader default, and it also overrides the renderQueue set in .mate. It additionally writes the shader property _SetManualRenderQueue, which is copied along with the game's own URP conversion
PMatAssetsEditor.target_id_tooltip: targetId — the target ID must match the ID of the target .mate, and the .pmat file name must be identical to that material's name; both must match for the override to apply. Note that KCES MOD EDITOR recomputes IDs when saving, so after renaming a file, reopen the mate file to confirm the latest ID
